implementation: DataCryptor 2000 (DC2K) X.25/IP/ATM Hardware Version Issue 2 and 3; Software Version 3.1
description: The Datacryptor 2000 X.25/IP/ATM is a stand-alone multi-chip cryptographic module that secures communications through these network protocols using signed Diffie-Hellman key exchange and Triple-DES encryption. The unit also provides integrated secure unit management capability employing the same techniques used for traffic encryption.
